item.title: Ocarina of Time Remake Destroyed: Summon Shops Anywhere, Dungeons Made Easier
item.description: Nintendo’s upcoming The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2 is introducing several changes that make the classic adventure considerably easier than its original Nintendo 64 release, yet another example of the games industry becoming more simplified for the sake of casuals.

item.title: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! Now Absurdly Sexy With Swimsuits
Japanese Man in His 70s Loses $240,000 After Being Offered $57,000 for His Sperm
item.description: A Japanese man in his 70s was reportedly defrauded of approximately 38 million yen ($240,000) after an individual he met online promised to pay him 9 million yen ($57,000) in exchange for donating his sperm.

item.title: Bandai Namco Reports Criminal Punishment for Person Who Sent Death Threats
item.description: Bandai Namco Entertainment has revealed that an individual who repeatedly sent death threats targeting its executives, employees, and other associates through the company’s official website has been identified and subjected to criminal punishment.

item.title: Former Take-Two AI Chief Warns AI Game Cloning Could Lead to More Invasive DRM
item.description: The rapid rise of AI-assisted game cloning could force publishers to introduce more restrictive digital rights management (DRM) and increasingly rely on cloud gaming, according to Take-Two Interactive’s former head of artificial intelligence.

item.title: Japan’s Actors Union Moves to Ban AI Recreation of Deceased Voice Actors
item.description: The Japan Actors Union has introduced new guidelines that generally prohibit recreating the voices of deceased actors and voice actors using generative AI, while also establishing strict consent and compensation requirements for living performers.

item.title: Seoul Plans to Shut Down Its Last Remaining Red-Light District Within a Year
item.description: Authorities in Seoul, South Korea, are stepping up efforts to eliminate the city’s last remaining major red-light district, with a local mayor pledging to resolve the issue within a year.

item.title: PlayStation Creator Ken Kutaragi Says Physical Discs “No Longer Make Economic Sense”
item.description: PlayStation creator Ken Kutaragi has acknowledged the frustration surrounding Sony’s decision to discontinue physical game releases, although he believes continuing to manufacture discs is becoming economically unreasonable.

item.title: 1 in 5 Japanese Elementary School Boys Own a Smartphone, Survey Finds
item.description: A new survey of Japanese elementary school boys has found that only around 20% own a smartphone, despite mobile devices becoming increasingly common in everyday life.

item.title: Indie Developer Cancels Game Demo Over Fears AI Could Copy It Before Release
item.description: The developers of an upcoming indie game have canceled its public demo over concerns that generative AI could be used to rapidly produce copycat games before the original is even released.

item.title: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru Sukumizu Ad at Train Station Triggers Feminist Whining

item.description: Nintendo’s upcoming remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has revealed the updated appearance of the Bombchu Bowling Alley attendant, a minor character whose redesign is attracting considerable attention from fans.

item.title: Japanese Mosque’s Muslims Patrolling Streets Near Elementary Schools & Kindergarten
item.description: A group of Muslims associated with a mosque in Ichikawa, Chiba Prefecture, Japan, has established a volunteer neighborhood patrol organization, with members beginning to monitor streets near local elementary schools and a kindergarten.

item.title: PlayStation Creator Says Industry Has Fallen Behind AI, Claims Tech Progress Has Stalled
item.description: PlayStation creator Ken Kutaragi believes the video game industry has fallen behind advances in artificial intelligence, arguing that modern games have made relatively little technological progress despite increasingly large development budgets.

item.title: Konami President Says AI “Won’t Significantly Change Gaming Industry”
item.description: Konami Digital Entertainment president Hideki Hayakawa believes artificial intelligence will not fundamentally transform the video game industry, arguing that human creativity remains essential to producing innovative games.

item.title: Castlevania Devs Say They Purposely “Made Characters Hot”, Expected Suggestive Fan Art
item.description: The developers of Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse have confirmed that making the game’s characters sexually attractive was an intentional design choice, and they’re pleased with the “enthusiastic response from fans”, though many are wondering where exactly the “sexual attractive” characters are…

item.title: Nexus Mods Bans Gears of War: E-Day Mod That Replaces Pride Flags
item.description: Nexus Mods has reportedly banned a mod for Gears of War: E-Day that replaces the game’s Pride-themed profile artwork with an existing promotional image featuring a family – an instance of censorship that is highly common on the modding site.

item.title: Atelier Karia Now Letting Players Make Its Heroine Gain Weight
item.description: Koei Tecmo and Gust have confirmed that Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories will feature a body-shape system that allows protagonist Karia to gain weight depending on how much she eats, following overwhelmingly positive feedback from fans.
